description.text: The third expansion pack of the ADV series, released on 25 June 2003. As its name says, it is full of Dragon Pokémon roaming the skies, among them Rayquaza, Flygon and Salamence, with Plusle and Minun too. Many of its dragons were the first Pokémon in the card game with two Resistances. The cards are numbered to 54. In English it became EX Dragon in November 2003.
